title: [SEP-8] IOs other than relays (TURN, SFU, sequencer) have no S7 binding, and the sequencer ignores
description: Review finding SEP-8: IOs other than relays (TURN, SFU, sequencer) have no S7 binding, and the sequencer ignores the §6.2 proof (lens SEP). Location: spec/06-calls.md:110, 212; spec/14-jmap.md:166, 171, 178, 193; vs ARCHITECTURE.md:116-119 (S7). Fix: As proposed. One more concrete failure: the closing rule (14:178) reads `after` from "the operation at position 0 of a new epoch's stream". The sequencer "does not authenticate submitters" (14:166), so a non-member who saw the token can take position 0, and members skip that op at decryption (14:173), which leaves the closing head undefined. Requiring `accessSig` at the sequencer fits D2 ("Sequencer reads nothing"), because verifying the proof reads no content. 14:193's Space association holds only for Spaces whose state the operator can see (public Spaces, which are CO publications). Reword it rather than call it a §5 violation. Full text: notes/review/SEP-verified.md and notes/review/SEP.md.
